definitions.explanation: Money coming into an account or being deposited.

examples.japanese: {入金|にゅうきん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{給料|きゅうりょう}→給料：01086_kyuuryou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{入金|にゅうきん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{入金|にゅうきん}⟦{日|び}→日：02249_hi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧25⟦{日|にち}→日：12732_nichi⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: The payment date is the 25th of every month.

notes:
{入金|にゅうきん} refers to money being deposited into or received in an account. It covers both the act of depositing and the receipt of payment. Commonly used in banking, business, and accounting contexts.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {入金|にゅうきん}する: to deposit, to make a payment
- {入金|にゅうきん}⟦{確認|かくにん}→確認：00158_kakunin⟧: deposit confirmation
- {入金|にゅうきん}⟦{日|び}→日：02249_hi⟧: payment/deposit date
- {入金|にゅうきん}⟦{通知|つうち}→通知：04061_tsuuchi⟧: deposit notification
- {入金|にゅうきん}⟦{済|ず}み→〜済み：04013_zumi⟧: payment completed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {入金|にゅうきん}: money coming in (deposit, payment received)
- ⟦{出金|しゅっきん}→出金：05468_shukkin⟧: money going out (withdrawal, disbursement)
- ⟦{送金|そうきん}→送金：09774_soukin⟧: remittance, sending money
- ⟦{振込|ふりこ}み→振込：05421_furikomi⟧: bank transfer

FORMS:
{入|にゅう} (entering) + {金|きん} (money). Literally "money entering."
